config_fields.name: customer_number
config_fields.help: Your Ingram Micro reseller customer number (IM-CustomerNumber header, e.g. 20-222222).

config_fields.name: country_code
config_fields.help: Two-letter ISO country of your Ingram Micro account (IM-CountryCode header, e.g. US).

config_fields.name: sender_id
config_fields.help: Optional sender identification text (IM-SenderID header, max 32 chars).

config_fields.name: customer_contact
config_fields.help: E-mail of the logged-in user (IM-CustomerContact header); required by Freight Estimate (quote_shipping).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID (Consumer Key) of your app on developer.ingrammicro.com (My Apps); production keys after app approval.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client Secret of the same app; exchanged for a bearer token at /oauth/oauth30/token (client_credentials).

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe runs a one-row Product Search (GET /resellers/v6/catalog). `sign` is used only to stamp every request with a fresh 32-hex IM-CorrelationID ('Unique transaction number to identify each transaction', maxLength 32); nothing is signed.

list_products.note: Search Products (GET /resellers/v6/catalog): keyword = Ingram part number, vendor part number, title or vendor name; category e.g. 'Displays'; max 100 per page. Search returns no price — use get_product for details (price & availability is POST /resellers/v6/catalog/priceandavailability).

get_product.note: Product Details (GET /resellers/v6/catalog/details/{ingramPartNumber}, 6-char Ingram part number): description, vendor, category, indicators, dimensions and weights in `raw`; no price.

quote_shipping.note: Freight Estimate (POST /resellers/v6/freightestimate) for one Ingram part number to a destination country; one option per ship-from branch with its default carrier (shipVia, freightRate, transitDays) and the alternative carriers in `carriers`. Needs the customer_contact config field (IM-CustomerContact header). Currency is freightEstimateResponse.currencyCode in `raw`.

create_order.note: Create your Order v6 (POST /resellers/v6/orders). Pass `items` in Ingram form [{customerLineNumber, ingramPartNumber, quantity}] and `shipping_address` as shipToInfo {contact, companyName, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, postalCode, countryCode, phoneNumber, email}; `shipping_option` is a carrier code from quote_shipping. The required customerOrderNumber (max 18) is generated as MCP+yyMMddHHmmss (UTC). Orders are placed on your credit account.

get_order.note: Get Order Details v6.1 (GET /resellers/v6.1/orders/{ordernumber}, e.g. 20-RD3QV): orderStatus, totals, lines[] with lineStatus and shipmentDetails[].carrierDetails[].trackingDetails[] in `raw`; tracking_number is the first line's first parcel.

track.note: Order lines of Get Order Details v6.1 as shipment events: lineStatus plus the first shipment's carrier, tracking number/URL and shipped/delivered dates per line.

adapter.terms: Production base https://api.ingrammicro.com:443 (the spec's sandbox server is https://api.ingrammicro.com:443/sandbox). Reseller API access requires an Ingram Micro reseller account and app approval.

evidence: host api.ingrammicro.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 7/7 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 7/7 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
